info.title: Jetski API
info.description: Implemented Jetski HTTP API. Host-control protocol, checkpoint formats and runtime compatibility are independently versioned. See the operations and qualification guides for supported boundaries.

post.description: Checkpoint copies default to filesystem content. Explicit content=memory requires a retained portable-memory checkpoint, the same owner and source image. It publishes independently scoped disk and immutable RAM objects into a distinct stopped sandbox; resume-memory remains a separate, compatibility-gated operation. Memory state and external credentials are cloned: clients must reconnect external sessions and avoid duplicating non-idempotent side effects.

post.summary: Suspend process memory after durable filesystem publication

202.description: Persisted operation; observe its ID for completion

404.description: Sandbox unavailable in principal scope

post.description: Experimental, capability-gated process suspension. Without portable options only the filesystem is remotely durable and RAM stays on the original host. Portable options atomically publish verified memory chunks with the matching filesystem root; restoration requires a compatible gVisor host. Both modes retain exclusive host ownership while suspended. Observe the persisted operation; never replay uncertain native effects.

post.summary: Resume compatible memory or explicitly recover the retained filesystem

202.description: Persisted operation; observe its ID for completion

404.description: Sandbox unavailable in principal scope

post.description: Experimental, capability-gated memory suspension. Requires settled commands, terminals, connections and uploads. Keeps exclusive host ownership; R2 or the configured checkpoint store remains the independent durable filesystem recovery authority. Memory resume is a separate operation.
